q: Which four weddings are the Four Vows?
detail:
TWO DOCUMENTS FROM VIRAENA DISAGREE, AND THE ARCHIVE IS NOT PICKING.

THE FILED READING: Maddy × Cora · Harley × Yvaine · VIOLET × NOVA · Izzy × Fiona.

THE ARC 11 OUTLINE, delivered 7 September: Maddy × Cora · LIVI × RAE · Harley × Yvaine · Izzy × Fiona.

AND THE SAME MESSAGE PUTS LIVI AND RAE'S WEDDING IN ARC 10 AS ITS FOURTH MAJOR BEAT — 'Strategist and Gremlin finally marry (engaged since Arc 5)' — which is also where the Archive already had it. So Livi and Rae appear to be married twice, one arc apart, in the same pair of documents.

TWO THINGS NEED A RULING. Do Livi and Rae marry in Arc 10 or Arc 11? And are Violet and Nova one of the Four Vows, or did the Archive place a wedding that belongs elsewhere?

EVERYTHING ELSE IN BOTH OUTLINES AGREED. This is the only seam.

ANSWERED 7 SEPTEMBER. THE FOUR ARE MADDY × CORA, HARLEY × YVAINE, VIOLET × NOVA, AND IZZY × FIONA. The Archive's filed reading was correct. Livi and Rae marry ONCE, in ARC 10 — the Arc 11 outline listed them a second time in error. RETIRED.
